q: of the greatest conclusion and confusion
(On this day of Qiyaamat, the hearts will quiver and shudder out of extreme alarm and terror).
v.h: Fate of the Righteous and the Wicked

q: What is this Day of greatest conclusion and confusion?
you what is Day of the greatest conclusion and confusion?
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is?

q: (running in confusion towards the Plain of Reckoning)...
v.s: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
v.c: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths,

q: (that we remember to be so substantial)
v.s: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
v.c: and the mountains will be like carded wool.

v.s: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
v.c: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,

v.s: He will be in a pleasant life.
v.c: they will be in a life of bliss.

q: As for him whose scales are light
(with good deeds but heavy with evil deeds)...
v.s: But as for one whose scales are light,
v.c: And as for those whose scale is light,

v.s: His refuge will be an abyss.
v.c: their home will be the abyss.

q: How will you know what this
v.s: And what can make you know what that is?
v.c: And what will make you realize what that is?

q: (of Jahannam). (A Hadith states that a stone cast into Jahannam will continue falling for seventy years without reaching the bottom.)
v.s: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
